name: webpack-5110-html-minify-repro
description: Minimal reproduction: webpack 5.110 built-in HTML minifier deduplicates the repeated %} delimiter in copy-webpack-plugin .html assets

scripts.compare: for f in src/*.html; do d="dist/$(basename "$f")"; echo "== $f -> $d =="; echo "  in : $(cat "$f")"; echo "  out: $(cat "$d")"; done
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run compare
